Name: Alex Loves Energy Tonic and Muscle Remedy
Author: chocolatte12
Description:
Have you ever noticed that energy tonic and muscle remedy are universally hated items?

Does that make any sense to you?

Alex loves working out - he should consider these items essential for his exercise.

This mod fixes that. Now Alex will love these pro-muscle building items, just like he should have all along.
